name: Extra Amount Option For WooCommerce Checkout (BASIC)
author: WPSuperiors Developer

sections.description:
This plugin will auto-apply an extra amount on woocommerce checkout based on Payment Gateway,Shipping,Category,Type,Products.

✤ Customizable Options For Admin ✤

❶ To Add/Edit/Delete more than one, unlimited extra amount options for checkout.
❷ To change the label for extra fees or amounts.
❸ To change the amount to be applied at checkout.
❹ To choose the amount will be applied as either a PERCENTAGE of cart value or a FIXED amount.
❺ To choose the conditions (Individual Product, Product Category, Product Type, Shipping Location, Payment Gateway) for applying the amount.
❺ To customize the admin order notification email separately.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WooCommerce 2.5 requires WordPress 4.1+
  • WooCommerce 2.6 requires WordPress 4.4+

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “Extra Amount For WooCommerce Checkout” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our plugin.You can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.
And activate it.
*Keep In Mind, Before activating “Extra Amount For WooCommerce Checkout” activate “WooCommerce”

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our plugin and uploading it to your webserver via your favourite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Goto WooCommerce->Extra Amount For WooCommerce Checkout, and play with settings.
